scope: read-only source review, not runtime acceptance
reviewer: journal_integration_review; author of logging storage, not author of reviewed script/CLI/worker

findings.fact: An exception during one finalization/artifact operation escapes main finally, skipping remaining child/socket cleanup and final summary; primary failure is still only in memory.
findings.requested_fix: Checkpoint primary error, independently record collection errors and continue all cleanup/collection, preserve original failure.
findings.status: Root authorized script-only fix; author retained initial SHA ab3fb0fb.

confirmed_source_contracts: RLIMIT_FSIZE is applied only after real virtual ready, two actual imports/configuration replies and pending-IN snapshots; limit is active original inode size plus 16, below segment rotation ceiling.
SIGXFSZ is ignored in an exec wrapper and actual child SigIgn is checked before prlimit. Actual child exe/UID identity and original active-file FD dev/inode are sampled.

The partial same-inode file is retained, held-after-failure snapshot must still have both owners/pending INs, then TERM must emit fully released stopped snapshot and exit 1 with fixed logging failure plus os error 27.
main awaits execute before synchronous LogOwner.shutdown with Tokio runtime still alive. File mode has no stderr tee, final failure output occurs after owner and logger return.

Local LogObserver cancellation awaits the original blocking read JoinHandle; it does not abort the read or stop USB. Accepted agent read is retained by actual reader workers after RPC client cancellation.

Worker startup ownership/Drop, two readers plus two queue slots, closing admissions, real reader joins before final writer observation, and original storage I/O error return paths have no additional concrete blocker in the reviewed source.
limits: No subprocess script execution, Cargo, QEMU, USB action, Git write or repository edit performed by this review.
Only source predicates reviewed; no claimed runtime EFBIG or virtual cleanup success.
Actual data-socket EOF is sampled after child wait, so it is not a pre-exit timestamp claim. The stopped event plus product ownership order is the pre-exit cleanup contract.
RLIMIT_FSIZE affects regular-file writes including stderr; the actual errno assertion is product diagnostic plus partial-file evidence, not an independent syscall trace.
Hard-blocked filesystem can block real reader/writer join; no bounded exit or fake cancellation guarantee.
Primary runner reuses fixed virtual wire/predicate helpers from test-server-signals.py; this review did not invoke either runner.
